header.running_head: Statements of the Sahabah (RA) Concerning Their Qualities

blocks.text:
Abu Sa'eed Maqbari (RAH) reports that when Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah bin Jarraah (RA) contracted a plague, he instructed Hadhrat Mu'aadh bin Jabal (RA) to lead the salaah, which the latter did. When Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah bin Jarraah (RA) passed away, Hadhrat Mu'aadh addressed the people saying, "O people! Sincerely repent to Allaah for your sins because when any servant of Allaah meets Allaah after he sincerely repents for his sins, Allaah's forgiveness is assured."
Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) then proceeded to say, "You have been grieved by the loss of a man whom I swear had a heart more free from malice than any other I have seen. I have not seen another with a purer heart, who was further from evil, who had as much love for the Aakhirah and who cared more for the well-being of the masses. Pray for mercy to be showered on him and make for the open plain to perform his funeral prayer. I swear by Allaah that you shall never have another leader like him."
The people gathered together and the bier of Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA) was taken to the plain where Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) led the funeral prayer. When the corpse was brought to the grave, Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA), Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA) and Hadhrat Dahaak bin Qais (RA) entered the grave to lay the body to rest. When they emerged from the grave, they closed the grave with sand and (standing at the head-side of the grave) Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) addressed the deceased saying, "O Abu Ubaydah! I shall certainly heap praises on you but will say nothing untrue because I fear that it may incur Allaah's wrath. By Allaah! As far as I know, you were certainly from among those people who abundantly engaged in the Dhikr of Allaah, who walked humbly on earth and who would greet (and part company from) foolish people when they addressed you (to avoid disputes). You were among those who would neither be miserly nor wasteful when spending in charity, but who display excellent moderation between the two extremes. By Allaah! You were among those whose hearts submitted to Allaah, who displayed humility, who were compassionate towards orphans and the poor and who detested the behaviour of treacherous and arrogant people." [^1]

Hadhrat Rib'ee bin Hiraash (RAH) narrates that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) once sought permission to meet Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) at a time when members of various tribes of the Quraysh were with him. As Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) approached, Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) said to Hadhrat Sa'eed bin Al Aas (RA) who was on his right-hand side, "I shall present to Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) such questions that he will be unable to answer." Hadhrat Sa'eed (RA) replied, "There is none like Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) to answer your questions."
